query: Gather the pages under the asyncio section of the Python documentation so I can ask questions about them.
expected_behavior: Uses web_map or web_crawl to discover relevant same-domain URLs instead of guessing them
Bounds the work (e.g. --search asyncio with sensible --max-pages / --max-depth) to avoid runaway crawling
Collects the page content as Markdown via web_read or web_crawl
Reports which URLs were used as sources
